title: Apple is preparing to launch! It is secretly planning to introduce paid real-time news with major publishers
excerpt: To enable the highly anticipated next-generation Siri AI with powerful real-time information retrieval capabilities, Apple has recently been in deep discussions
content_html:
To enable the highly anticipated next-generation Siri AI with powerful real-time information retrieval capabilities, Apple has recently been in deep discussions with major news publishers, planning to pay them for their content.

According to insiders, the core purpose of Apple's outreach to publishers is to grant the newly upgraded voice assistant the ability to access real-time news and various current affairs. In terms of the cooperation model, Apple has not adopted the common industry practice of a fixed lump-sum licensing fee, but instead prefers an innovative dynamic compensation mechanism based on usage volume - that is, settlement will be made according to the actual frequency of content being accessed. It is reported that Apple has even prepared a huge budget of up to nine figures for this content collaboration.

Looking back, Apple had previously promised to launch a smarter and more versatile AI assistant, but related features have been delayed from being fully implemented. With this recent contact with mainstream content sources coming to light, the industry generally expects that the new Siri AI with significant functional improvements is expected to be officially released to the public later this year.

content_html_zh:
为了让备受期待的下一代 Siri AI 具备强大的实时信息检索能力，苹果最近与各大新闻出版商进行了深入讨论，计划向他们的内容付费。

业内人士表示，苹果向出版商伸出援手的核心目的是让新升级的语音助手能够获取实时新闻和各种时事。 在合作模式上，苹果并没有采用行业通行的一次性固定授权费的做法，而是更倾向于创新的基于使用量的动态补偿机制——即根据内容的实际访问频率进行结算。 据悉，苹果甚至为这次内容合作准备了高达九位数的巨额预算。

回想起来，苹果此前曾承诺推出更智能、更全能的AI助手，但相关功能迟迟未能全面落地。 随着近期与主流内容源的接触曝光，业界普遍预计功能显着改进的全新 Siri AI 有望在今年晚些时候正式向公众发布。
